page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head centred at the top and the page number at top right. The closing lines are set as an indented sign-off block below the text: "E collegio..." at left and "Rev. Vest..." at right, then "Tho. Comberus." at right. At the foot: signature "P 3" at left and catchword "Quod" at right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Judæorum sensu. Nostros quod attinet,
præsertim vero eos, qvi Hebræo Judæo-
rum textui addictiores sunt, licet suffice-
re etiam versiones non inficientur, hoc
unum forte dabit solicitos, qvo numero
& loco, qvo honore & gradu Samarita-
na hæc, eodem scilicet & pari, an etiam
priori qvam Hebræa, sint habenda. Qvi-
bus enim ajunt concredita sunt eloqvia
Dei? Qvæ ab Esdra sunt, potiora dicis,
an qvæ à Dositheo & Zacharia? Sed de
his plura & meliora vobis sub prælo esse
non dubitamus. Vestrum jam erit Vir
Rev. qvod candide offerimus, æqvi bo-
niqve consulere: Prolixitati etiam huic
nostræ in qvam nec opini incidimus a-
mice ignoscere. Jam enim vobis stu-
diisqve vestris bene precati epistolam
claudimus. Vale V.R. meqve vicissim
tibi commendatissimum habe.
E
collegio Sanctæ &
Indiv. Trin. quod
est apud Cantabr. Apr, 25. 1633.
Tho. Comberus.

page.notes: The page-number "317" is printed in old-style figures; the closing line "Apr, 25. 1633." has the 25 and 1633 in old-style numerals as printed. The catchword "Quod" is partly cut off at the right edge, so its last letter is uncertain. The date line and the italic signature are transcribed as printed, without changes.
